title: SpectralTrain: A Universal Framework for Hyperspectral Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2511.16084v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification typically involves large-scale data and computationally intensive training, which limits the practical deployment of deep learning models in real-world remote sensing tasks. This study introduces SpectralTrain, a universal, architecture-agnostic training framework that enhances learning efficiency by integrating curriculum learning (CL) with principal component analysis (PCA)-based spectral downsampling. By gradually introducing spectral complexity while preserving essential information, SpectralTrain enables efficient learning of spectral -- spatial patterns at significantly reduced computational costs. The framework is independent of specific architectures, optimizers, or loss functions and is compatible with both classical and state-of-the-art (SOTA) models. translated_title: SpectralTrain：一个通用的高光谱图像分类框架
translated_abstract: 高光谱图像（HSI）分类通常涉及大规模数据和计算密集型的训练过程，这限制了深度学习模型在现实世界遥感任务中的实际部署。本研究提出了SpectralTrain，一个通用的、与架构无关的训练框架，它通过将课程学习（CL）与基于主成分分析（PCA）的光谱降采样相结合来提升学习效率。通过在保留关键信息的同时逐步引入光谱复杂性，SpectralTrain能够以显著降低的计算成本高效地学习光谱-空间模式。该框架不依赖于特定的架构、优化器或损失函数，并与经典模型和最先进（SOTA）模型均兼容。在三个基准数据集——Indian Pines、Salinas-A以及新提出的CloudPatch-7——上进行的大量实验表明……
tldr: SpectralTrain是一个与架构无关的通用训练框架，通过结合课程学习与基于PCA的光谱降采样，在显著降低计算成本的同时实现高光谱图像分类的高效学习。
en_tdlr: SpectralTrain is an architecture-agnostic training framework that combines curriculum learning with PCA-based spectral downsampling to enable efficient hyperspectral image classification at significantly reduced computational costs.
